verdict.rationale: The evidence documents patent litigation, IP litigation, trademark prosecution and technology transactions. None of it describes patent prosecution, drafting or filing patent applications, or patent portfolio strategy, and no named patent prosecutors or group page appear. Patent disputes and trademark application work are related but different capabilities, so they earn no credit for this story.
